prompt: This helper recovers a name from a 12-byte field of a directory record. It accepts a byte pattern it must reject, so one name can have several spellings on disk. Tap the line responsible.
explain: After the first NUL every remaining byte must also be zero. Returning at once lets `a\0\0x\0...` decode to the same name as `a\0\0\0...`, so a duplicate check on the string cannot see the difference. The padding is part of the format.
